newsitem.title: USA: Burr-Brown sees 15-20 pct annual rev growth.
newsitem.headline: Burr-Brown sees 15-20 pct annual rev growth.

text.p: Burr-Brown Corp said Monday it expects to maintain an annual revenue growth rate in the range of 15 to 20 percent "for the forseeable future."

Business conditions remain strong and the company was particularly encouraged by the high level of interest in its new products, President and Chief Executive Officer Syrus Madavi said in a statement.
Also on Monday, the company reported that second quarter revenue increased to $62.5 million from $58.2 million in the year-ago second quarter.
